faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT Delhi) for filling administrative positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Administrative Officer under Advt. No.32/2026 on a contractual employment basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Administrative Officer post in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 27 October 2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree with 3 years experience, an Engineering degree with 2 years experience, or a Post Graduate degree with 1 year experience, securing at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 32 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of INR 590 online.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for SC, ST, and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, SC, ST, PwD, Women, and Internal candidates are exempted from paying the application fee and pay INR 0.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Administrative Officer position will be placed under Pay Level 4.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I submit my online application?
faq.answer: You can submit your online application by visiting the official recruitment portal link provided on the official IIIT Delhi website.
